subtitle: Makes the paths on the world map easier to see by drawing it like the minimap!
description:
The world map's art makes it hard to tell where you can actually go. This mod draws the map outlines over the world map, so every path, area and edge stands out, just like on the minimap.

Two sliders in the Mods tab of the game's settings change the look. Map Opacity sets how visible the game's own map is behind the outlines, and Outline Opacity sets how visible the outlines are. Turn the map down for the full minimap look, or keep it up to see the outlines over the regular map.

Requirements

  • Blueprint Loader, which loads this mod

Install

  1. Close the game, and fully close the Minecraft Launcher if you use it.
  2. Open your Minecraft Dungeons II Paks folder.
    • Steam: Right click the game in your library, then Manage > Browse local files, then open Dungeons\Content\Paks
    • Minecraft Launcher: C:\XboxGames\Minecraft Dungeons II\Content\Dungeons\Content\Paks
    If you picked a different install folder in the Minecraft Launcher, it is Minecraft Dungeons II\Content\Dungeons\Content\Paks inside that folder.
  3. Create a folder called ~mods inside the Paks folder if there is not one already.
  4. Open the zip and move the ClearerWorldMap folder inside it into ~mods, so the files end up like this: Paks\~mods\ClearerWorldMap\ClearerWorldMap_P.pak

Uninstall

Delete the ClearerWorldMap folder from ~mods.
